name: SO4AG Retail
description: Ten parameters a customer asks about before ordering from an online shop: delivery, payment, returns. Every scope key restricts where a claim applies; the value any means all values of that key.

scope_keys.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the delivery country
scope_keys.delivery_method: Delivery method code: courier, pickup_point, parcel_locker, post, store_pickup, any
scope_keys.branch: URI of the store or pickup place

operator.description: Legal entity operating the shop. Identifiers SHOULD include a registry number (cz-ico, sk-ico, lei).

branch.description: The shop's own store or pickup place with address and optional opening hours. The claim subject is the place URI.

shippingPrice.description: Price of delivering a standard parcel including VAT. With bound = minimum the shop states a starting price. Oversized goods and cash-on-delivery fees are not part of this claim.

freeShippingFrom.description: Order value from which standard shipping is free. If the shop never offers free shipping, knowledge_state is not_applicable. Free shipping without a threshold is amount 0.00.

deliveryTime.description: Usual number of working days from order to delivery for goods in stock (unit d), or a short text when the rule cannot be expressed as days. Never a guarantee for a specific order.

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods the shop accepts. cash_on_delivery = payment to the carrier on delivery; cash = payment in the shop's own store.

cashOnDeliveryFee.description: Extra fee for paying on delivery. 0.00 means free. If the shop does not offer cash on delivery, knowledge_state is not_applicable.

returnPeriod.description: Number of days from delivery within which a consumer may return goods without giving a reason (unit d).

warrantyPeriod.description: Warranty or liability period for new goods sold to consumers in months (unit mo).

storePickup.description: Whether an order can be collected in person at the shop's own store or pickup place.
